body: Owner decision 2026-11-08: one cache database per project at ~/.pman/cache/<projectId>/db.sqlite (PMAN_HOME), outside the repository. Tables for index, embeddings (content-addressed, shared across worktrees/branches) and fingerprints; rows keyed by checkout root + file; WAL + busy_timeout, short write transactions, best-effort updates with keyword fallback; node:sqlite, no native deps. See docs/implementation-decisions.md 'Local cache database'.
author: local
